image_description: A full-body side view of an American Bison standing on a dirt path with grass in the background. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to smoother, lighter brown fur on the hindquarters. It has a large head with short curved horns and a visible beard. All four legs are visible, ending in dark hooves. A short tail with a tuft is visible at the rear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, appearing large and broad relative to the body. Short, curved horns are distinctly present on the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the description of a bison beard.
The eye is visible on the side of the head and appears dark/black, consistent with the species.
Small, triangular ears are visible protruding from the thick fur on the head; they are not completely hidden but are small and surrounded by fur as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive, heavy build. The shoulder region (withers) is significantly higher than the hips, creating the characteristic sloping back profile of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur that creates a very prominent hump at the shoulders.
There is a clear visual transition from the shaggy front to the hindquarters, which have shorter, smoother, and slightly lighter-colored fur.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively small and short in proportion to the massive size of the head and body.
All four legs are visible and appear sturdy. The feet end in dark, split structures consistent with cloven hooves.
A short tail ending in a distinct bushy tuft of hair is visible hanging behind the hind legs.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the connection of the hump to the spine, ensuring no limb fusion or extra limbs.
To check for 'melting' artifacts where the shaggy fur meets the background, a common AI failure mode for hairy subjects.
To assess texture consistency between the shaggy front and smooth rear, and check for general generation artifacts.

focus_areas: Fur texture transition between forequarters and hindquarters
Leg-hoof connectivity and ground contact shadows
Boundary sharpness of the shaggy mane against the background
Anatomical correctness of the shoulder hump
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy front fur and the smoother rear fur. AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Also, inspect the hooves for 'floating' effects or lack of clear separation from the dirt ground. Verify that the shoulder hump connects logically to the neck and spine without anatomical distortion.
